description: This file defines the IncludeTokenParser class which handles parsing of the 'include' tag in Twig templates, allowing for template inclusion with specified options.

classes.name: IncludeTokenParser
classes.description: A parser class for the 'include' tag in Twig templates, responsible for parsing include statements and arguments.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'include' tag and returns an IncludeNode representing the include statement.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses additional arguments such as 'with', 'only', and 'ignore missing' options.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'include', identifying the tag this parser handles.
